5,945 likes, 52 comments - jclacooks on July 13, 2026: "PAD KEE MAO 🇹🇭
AKA Drunken Noodles

Make sure you adjust the flavors to your taste. More Fish sauce and light soy sauce if it isn’t salty enough. Dark soy sauce is mainly for the color. Oyster sauce for some sweetness and umami. 

Ingredients:

10oz fresh rice noodles
2-3 chicken thighs 
Thai chilis to preferred spice 
5-10 cloves garlic
Handful of Thai basil or holy basil if you can find it
Green onions 
1/2 a Bell pepper
1/4 Onion

Sauce:

1tbsp oyster sauce
2 tbsp fish sauce
1 tbsp light soy sauce
1tbsp dark soy sauce
2 tsp white pepper
1tbsp palm sugar
MSG optional 

1. Slice chicken thighs into cubes then marinate for a couple minutes with dark soy sauce and white pepper.
2. Pound or mince garlic and thai chilis together to make a paste
3. Cook your chicken all the way through then set aside
4. Add more oil to the same pan then sauté your chili garlic paste until fragrant. 
5. Add your sliced onions, bell pepper, and green onion and toss together to sweat the onions
6. Add your chicken back in then add your noodles
7. Now add your sauce, you can prepare it before hand or add it directly to the pan. 
8. Mix well and try not to break the noodles
9. Turn off the heat and add your thai basil in and toss together 
10. Enjoy

#thaifood #padkeemao #noodles".

audio.transcript: Does Thailand create the best noodle dish of all time? Today we're making Pad Kee Mao, also known as drunken noodles. It's the spicy cousin of the equally popular Pad See Ew, and in my opinion, 100 times better than Pad Thai. The flavors are bolder, spicier, and more complex. You get that intense heat and earthiness from the fresh Thai chilies, garlic, and basil. Then you get hit with that deep, savory, salty, sweetness from the oyster sauce and fish sauce. It's really just a flavor bomb. And if you want to learn how to make it, the full recipe is in the description with instructions. Enjoy.
